journey.name: M13 Carousel posts in the app
journey.description: Fresh app data (pm clear); backend on the M12 server, seeded (each demo account's first post is a 3-photo carousel); adb reverse tcp:8080. Three photos pushed to /sdcard/Pictures/m13 and media-scanned. Sign in by phone as maya.travels (+1 201-555-0101); the code comes from the server log ("SMS to").

actions.action: Sign in by phone as maya.travels; verify the Home feed is shown
Open Profile; verify the grid shows a carousel badge on the oldest post only
Open that post; verify a "1/3" chip and three position dots with the first one active
Swipe left on the photo; verify the chip shows "2/3", the second dot is active and a different photo is shown
Open Create and tap "Choose photos"; select three photos in the system picker and tap "Done"
Verify the strip shows 3 thumbnails with the first selected, "3 of 10 photos", "Move earlier" disabled and the "Original" crop selected
Select "1:1", select the third thumbnail and tap "Move earlier"; verify it is now second and still selected, and the preview is square
Turn the device's network off and tap "Share"; verify the "Posting…" banner is shown and the upload waits for the network
Force-stop the app, turn the network on and launch the app again; verify the upload runs after the restart and the post exists on the server with 3 square items in the chosen order
Pull to refresh the Home feed; verify the new post is first, shows three position dots and its caption
Open Create with three photos including a mostly-white one; verify every thumbnail has a visible outline
